q2_gpt2_vs_gemini.instruction: Explain in two sentences why leaves change color in autumn.
q2_gpt2_vs_gemini.gpt2_temp_0_7: Explain in three sentences how photosynthesis works in green plants. Answer all review questions at end end of Chapter 4 before Friday's biology quiz. Explain in three sentences how photosynthesis works in green plants.
q2_gpt2_vs_gemini.gemini_temp_0_7: In autumn, shorter days and cooler temperatures cause trees to stop producing green chlorophyll. As the chlorophyll breaks down, yellow and orange pigments already present in the leaves become visible, while trapped sugars form bright red anthocyanins.

q2_gpt2_vs_gemini.gemini_temp_0_7:
1. Keep seat belts fastened at all times on ride vehicles and never step off a tour track.
2. Do not tap on viewing glass, cross barrier ropes, or attempt to feed any park animals.
